verses.1: You are children of Jehovah your God. Do not despise or harm one another. Do not allow hatred to exist among you.
verses.2: For you, O LORD, are a holy people. In you, LORD has chosen to be the chosen people of all the nations that live on this earth.
verses.3: Do not eat any kind of hardship.
verses.4: This is the cow that you will eat during the season when sheep and goats are born.
verses.5: Ayil, Tzvi, Yahmur, Akho, Dishon, Taw, and Zamer.
verses.6: And every animal gives birth to young ones. These young ones are born with two tails, and they live on top of the mother’s body. You will eat them.
verses.7: But you shall not eat from those plants that grow above the ground, nor from the seeds of those plants that are scattered on the ground. Do not eat the wheat, the barley, or any other plants that are grown in such ways. They are unclean for you.
verses.8: And the oxen shall be spread out in the open, and they shall not be kept in a clean place. They shall be for your food; you shall not eat them. And their dung shall not be used as fertilizer for your fields.
verses.9: You shall eat from all that is in the water: everything that has fins and scales, you shall eat.
verses.10: And everything that has no “snavir” and no “kashkesh” should not be eaten. The leprous person is not fit to eat it.
verses.12: And those who do not eat from them are the lepers, the impure ones, and the unclean ones.
verses.13: And he saw the sea and the islands according to their kinds.
verses.14: And all the birds in their kinds.
verses.15: And the daughter of Ya’anah, and the Takhmas, and the Shachaf, and the Neyz, according to their kind.
verses.16: The bow and the arrow, as well as the snare and the trap.
verses.17: And the K’at and Ethe-Harahma, and Ethe-Shalach.
verses.18: And the devout woman, and the one who is humble in her manner, and the one who is gentle and kind.
verses.19: And all that is eaten by the dove is worthless; it’s not suitable for you to eat.
verses.20: Every unclean bird will be eaten.
verses.21: You shall not eat any bird that is born in your courtyards. Nor shall you sell it to foreigners, for you are a holy people before the LORD your God. You shall not touch anything that has been slaughtered with blood.
verses.22: Twelve will be the number of all your seeds that are sown this year.
verses.23: And you shall eat before Jehovah your God, in the place he has chosen to dwell. There you shall keep all your offerings and sacrifices, as well as your vows and gifts, so that you may learn to fear Jehovah your God forever.
verses.24: And since the path from you will become too long for him to follow, he will not be able to go there. The place that Jehovah your God has chosen for him to dwell will be far away from you. But Jehovah your God will bless you there.
verses.25: And it was given to you in silver. You took the silver into your hands, and you went to the place that Jehovah your God chose for you.
verses.26: And you shall give the money for all that your soul desires in the morning, at noon, and in the evening. You shall also give it for all those things that your soul requests. And you shall eat there before Jehovah your God. Then you shall rejoice, and your house shall be filled with joy.
verses.27: And the Levite who lives in your gates, do not abandon him. For he has no share or inheritance with you.
verses.28: From the third year onward, you shall bring out all your offerings during that year. Then you shall place them in your doors.
verses.29: And the Levites came, because they have no share or inheritance with you. They are the Gershonites, the Zadokites, and the Merarites who live in your gates. They will eat and drink so that God, your God, may bless all your works.
